_: jaws_le on JPSalas & marty's 'JAWS 50th Anniversary' 3.2, a scripted original:
vpxshadow.py keeps its script as a shadow game and hands the ball to the real
game. The LE card, not the Pro: the table has the LE's fourth flipper (the upper
one, LeftFlipperG, on the right button as Stern's UP P/F R FLIP is) and its shark
rising out of the lagoon. PAD-1311: the shark shows while the machine's SHARK UP-MAG
is made (PAD-1339: the tribute's pop-up targets in front of it stay down; SHARK HIT is the
newton ball in its mouth being knocked; PAD-1374: CHUM BUCKET TGT is the other one, JP's captive ball at
CaptiveKick1, knocked at any angle, not the first chum drop target it had to reach), and the fin is the chum line's seven targets,
the one at SHARK POSITION 1..7 standing while SHARK FIN UP/DOWN holds it up.
The five shark-shaped shot arrows (Lnight) are the beaches' RGB; JP's fireball bulbs
over the shark (fcroco) stay dark. PAD-1331: the middle lane's own trigger (Target2) is CENTER RAMP MADE
(Tcloseshark sits on the shark's return wire above it), JP's reel in THE POND's U-turn (Spinner2) is the
FISHING REEL MAG SW the machine counts its reel's turns on, and the sling GI bulbs' outlines are round
(round_lights): boxy ones cut their glow into a square over each sling. The lower playfield's inserts sit where Stern's do (the drawing fits
X = (x - 15) * 3.34, Y = (y - 15) * 3.13 below the boat); the upper third is JP's
own layout, so the switches up there are matched by what the script does with
them and the GUESS ones want a look at the machine. The table has no eject coils
(neither has the machine): its kickers keep their own script (orig_keep).
Ids: the RIG's switch_list.txt for jaws_le; coils through group_node.txt (group
7 = node 8, group 8 = node 9).
GI: the LE names no playfield GI LEDs, so the table's own GIUpdateTimer keeps its
GI on (not quieted); its attract shows, rainbow and insert effects are.
PAD-1366: the far right lane (EAST BEACH, Raft Attack) is the machine's RIGHT RAMP. JP raises a ramp in it (Ramphouse) at every
ball, so each shot climbs into Krampquint, which re-makes the ball at Krampquint1 on the left ramp's return wire (Ramp051);
it falls into Quint's hole (PyramidKicker) and on over LeftRampDone. Nothing in the lane was a switch, so the game heard a
LEFT RAMP. Krampquint is RIGHT RAMP MADE now and that ball's LeftRampDone is let by (unless PadQuintBall()). RightRampDone,
the top of the upper deck's helix (Ramp025/Ramp026, from the deck the upper flipper plays), is UP PF RAMP MADE, not the right
ramp; sw5 (under the deck, the top of JP's orbit) no longer stands in for it. JP's spinner at the lane's mouth (Spinner1 and
its bracket Primitive89) is not on Stern's game: off the table.

' PAD-1362: the return lanes, spotlights and Orca board light JP's lanterns and flashers, not stand-ins on bare art
' the quickshot lane's four triggers are the machine's switches: always live
Tquick1.Enabled = 1 : Tquick2.Enabled = 1 : Tquick3.Enabled = 1 : Tquick4.Enabled = 1
Sub PadPostL(e) : lockpostG.IsDropped = Not e : End Sub
Sub PadPostR(e) : lockpostD.IsDropped = Not e : End Sub
' ---- PAD-1311: the shark and the fin follow the machine
' The shark rises and sinks with the machine's SHARK UP-MAG / DOWN-MAG switches. The ball hits the shark itself
' PAD-1339: SHARK HIT is the newton ball in its mouth (JP's captive ball, made by CaptiveKick) being knocked while the
' shark is up. The tribute's four pop-up targets in front of it stay down: PAD-1311 stood two of them unseen at the
' ends of the SHARK! insert, and the ball bounced off nothing short of the newton ball.
' The fin is the tribute's seven chum line targets, one per SHARK POSITION 1..7 (switches 104 down to 98): the one
' where the fin is stands while SHARK FIN UP/DOWN holds it up, and a hit is SHARK FIN TGT.
Dim PadSharkUp, PadFinUp, PadFinAt, PadFins, PadFinSt(6), PadNewtonLook
PadSharkUp = False : PadFinUp = False : PadFinAt = 1 : PadNewtonLook = 0
' PAD-1374: the table's two newton balls, each counted when it is knocked from where it rests, at any angle:
' 0 the shark's, beside CaptiveKick (544, 485): SHARK HIT while the shark is up.
' 1 the chum bucket's, JP's captive ball at CaptiveKick1 (325, 582): CHUM BUCKET TGT. JP had it roll up its lane into the
' chum line's drop targets and only the first of them (Tchum1) was the switch: a knock off the straight never got there.
' A ball slowing at the top of its swing is not at rest: it is armed again only back within 8 units of its resting spot.
Dim PadNb(1), PadNbX(1), PadNbY(1), PadNbSlow(1), PadNbArmed(1), PadNbAtX, PadNbAtY
PadNbAtX = Array(544, 325) : PadNbAtY = Array(500, 582)
Set PadNb(0) = Nothing : Set PadNb(1) = Nothing
Sub PadNewtonTick   ' the newton balls: found once, before any ball is served
	Dim b, i
	If PadNewtonLook < 100 Then
		If PadNb(0) Is Nothing Or PadNb(1) Is Nothing Then
			PadNewtonLook = PadNewtonLook + 1
			For Each b In GetBalls
				For i = 0 To 1
					If PadNb(i) Is Nothing And Abs(b.X - PadNbAtX(i)) < 30 And Abs(b.Y - PadNbAtY(i)) < 70 Then
						Set PadNb(i) = b : PadNbX(i) = b.X : PadNbY(i) = b.Y : PadNbSlow(i) = 0 : PadNbArmed(i) = False
					End If
				Next
			Next
		End If
	End If
	If PadKnocked(0) And PadSharkUp Then vpmTimer.PulseSw 1081   ' SHARK HIT
	If PadKnocked(1) Then vpmTimer.PulseSw 1089   ' CHUM BUCKET TGT
End Sub
Function PadKnocked(i)   ' newton ball i knocked from rest: once a knock, however long it swings
	PadKnocked = False
	If PadNb(i) Is Nothing Then Exit Function
	Dim b, v, dx, dy : Set b = PadNb(i)
	v = b.VelX * b.VelX + b.VelY * b.VelY
	If v >= 1 Then
		PadNbSlow(i) = 0
		If v > 4 And PadNbArmed(i) Then PadNbArmed(i) = False : PadKnocked = True
		Exit Function
	End If
	PadNbSlow(i) = PadNbSlow(i) + 1
	If PadNbSlow(i) >= 10 Then PadNbX(i) = b.X : PadNbY(i) = b.Y   ' still for half a second: where it rests
	dx = b.X - PadNbX(i) : dy = b.Y - PadNbY(i)
	If PadNbSlow(i) >= 3 And dx * dx + dy * dy < 64 Then PadNbArmed(i) = True   ' still 150 ms where it rests
End Function
PadFins = Array(Tbeachfinal, Tnightfinal, Tbarrelshark, Tjackpot, Tsharkfinal, Thammerfinal, Tsmimerfinal)
Function PadSw(n)   ' the machine's switch plane; False when the controller cannot say
	PadSw = False
	On Error Resume Next
	PadSw = CBool(Controller.Switch(n + 0))
End Function
Sub PadFinUpDown(e) : PadFinUp = CBool(e) : End Sub
Sub PadStand(o, ByRef st, want)   ' a drop target held up (want) or down. st: 0 held down, 1 standing, 2+ knocked down that many ticks ago
	If Not want Then
		st = 0
		If Not o.IsDropped Then o.IsDropped = True
	ElseIf st = 0 Then
		o.IsDropped = False : st = 1
	ElseIf o.IsDropped Then
		st = st + 1
		If st >= 7 Then o.IsDropped = False : st = 1   ' up again 300 ms after the ball knocked it down
	Else
		st = 1
	End If
End Sub
Sub PadMechTimer_Timer
	On Error Resume Next
	Dim i, at, o
	If PadSw(1079) Then PadSharkUp = True
	If PadSw(1080) Then PadSharkUp = False
	If shark.Visible <> PadSharkUp Then shark.Visible = PadSharkUp
	For Each o In Array(Targetshark1, Targetshark2, Targetshark3, Targetshark4)
		If Not o.IsDropped Then o.IsDropped = True
	Next
	PadNewtonTick
	If Not Rsaveball.Collidable Then Rsaveball.Collidable = True   ' PAD-1339: JP's outlane save never opens
	at = 0
	For i = 1 To 7
		If PadSw(1105 - i) Then at = i
	Next
	If at > 0 Then PadFinAt = at
	For i = 0 To 6
		PadStand PadFins(i), PadFinSt(i), PadFinUp And PadFinAt = i + 1
	Next
End Sub
' PAD-1366: the far right ramp is RIGHT RAMP MADE, its ball is no left ramp, the deck's helix is UP PF RAMP MADE, no right spinner
Dim PadQuintBalls, PadQuintAt : PadQuintBalls = 0 : PadQuintAt = 0
Sub PadQuintIn   ' JP's Krampquint, without its flash: the ball goes on from Krampquint1, over the left ramp's LeftRampDone
	PadQuintBalls = PadQuintBalls + 1 : PadQuintAt = Timer
	Krampquint.DestroyBall
	Krampquint1.CreateBall
	Krampquint1.Kick 270, 5
End Sub
Function PadQuintBall()   ' the far right ramp's ball crossing LeftRampDone (Quint's hole holds it 3.5 s at most): once each
	PadQuintBall = False
	If PadQuintBalls <= 0 Then Exit Function
	If Abs(Timer - PadQuintAt) > 12 Then PadQuintBalls = 0 : Exit Function
	PadQuintBalls = PadQuintBalls - 1 : PadQuintBall = True
End Function

PAD-1362: `round` and `fields` do for a retrofit light what round_lights and item_fields do for the table's own. JP printed no
insert at any of these, and a clone keeps its source's outline: the deck's two red circles and the reel are small round glows,
not arrows. The return lanes, spotlights and Orca board (lit all game long) are JP's lanterns and flashers now, in `lamps`.

_: PAD-1339: the sling GI pairs gi1/gi2 and gi4/gi5 (falloff 230) each lit half a circle, cut along a straight line 31-41 units from
the bulb at a third of its brightness: the square yellow glow over each sling. Round now (round_lights), each at 18 not 25 so the pair
is no brighter than JP's halves. The sling lanterns (Lightlantern1-4, intensity 200) had a falloff 3-5x their outline: a hard yellow
disc on each post; their falloff ends at the outline now, at 60. KsaveR (JP's bait bucket under the left outlane, which fired the ball
back up when the green save arrow was lit) and KrampBoucle (on the Scars lane's top channel: it swallowed every ball that got there and
fired a new one round the loop at 30) are off: the machine has neither.
PAD-1356: KrampBoucle is on again (Mike: the ball cannot get up and over the Scars loop without it). The lanterns still bloomed:
each is a bulb with its bulb mesh shown, blinking at 60 (JP: 200) inside a gold lantern on the inlane plastic. No bulb mesh now,
steady, at 8 (the GI bulbs beside them are 15-25): a small warm glow on the plastic.
PAD-1362: f4 and f5, JP's backboard flashers (25, for a 1 s flash), are the Orca board, lit all game: at 15, as his f2, f7 and f9 are.
